source.whole_action_inspection: OBSERVED in prior durable Video Motion Pass 010 before decisive keys were chosen; historical bridge receipt is evidence only, this V2 repo specimen is the product.

observed: Actor A remains comparatively root-stable while Actor B closes from screen-right toward A.
Strongest measured native-frame image-change peak occurs at about 17.917 s, with motion energy already rising before 18.000 s.
Silhouettes overlap/cross around 18.000–18.250 s while B continues leftward.
By 18.500–18.750 s B shows a trailing upper-limb counter-arc toward screen-right while recovery begins.
inferred: Motion Dungeon connective geometry and key-hold allocation used for the abstract compilation are authored/inferred and are not source-authentic exposure claims.
unknown: Which actor is actively driving versus yielding
Whether silhouette overlap is a discrete physical impact

timing.key_timing_policy: OBSERVED source timestamps; no decisive key substitutes ONES/TWOS/FOURS for measured source timing
timing.pose_lab_vocabulary_note: ONES/TWOS/FOURS remain available only when timing must be INFERRED. User shorthand 1s/2s/4s means classes, never seconds.
timing.transport_cadence_firewall: stream FPS/raw frame count is not treated as performance cadence
timing.compile_policy: STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM-inspired key readability with explicit inferred holds inside measured key intervals; causal-boundary K4→K5 fails closed to a held K4 then a discrete K5 state change.

motion_dungeon.transition_rule: Interpolate only authored actor geometry while semantic support/contact/prop state remains the prior key until the next decisive key. If causal_boundary_to_next is true, hold the prior key and jump at the boundary.
